name: SuiteSync
tagline: Roommates search apartments together and rank them with quick pairwise choices.

awards: [CoStar Group] Sony WH-1000XM4 Wireless Noise Canceling Headphones​

problem: Group apartment hunting happens in messy chats and spreadsheets.
solution: A shared real-time search where a pairwise ranking narrows options quickly and captures everyone's opinion.
demo_moment: Team-described: compare two listings at a time until a winner emerges.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[CoStar Group] Sony WH-1000XM4 Wireless Noise Canceling Headphones​” among 112 submissions.
Uses a simple algorithm to resolve indecision.
